why_agent_cannot: an X account post or follow is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Join the whitelist The April 2025 announcement describes a whitelist for the points program, entered with an email and an EVM wallet address on the sign-up page .
2 Step 2 : Open the Cables app Launch the Cables app .
3 Step 3 : Stake assets Stake assets in the app, since the homepage names staking as the first way to build your position in the points program.
4 Step 4 : Refer others The homepage lists referring others as part of the program.
5 Step 5 : Grow your tier Keep staking and referring to raise your tier, which the project says unlocks future rewards. Follow Cables on X for program updates.
